description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AndroidLogFilterModel' that extends 'LogFilterModel'. It manages log filtering for Android logcat output, including log level filtering, custom filters, and message processing. It also contains an inner class 'AndroidLogFilter' for filtering by log level.

classes.name: AndroidLogFilterModel
classes.description: An abstract class managing Android logcat filtering, including log level, custom filters, and message processing.

classes.description: Inner class extending LogFilter, filtering log lines based on log level.
